id: title:jurajmajerik:don t crash metric tooltip on null values

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the tooltip display in the MetricsView experiment results, preventing potential rendering errors or confusing empty values when variant results are missing.
review.reason: Adds a null-safety check before formatting numbers, replacing missing values with a dash instead of potentially undefined or zero-formatted values. This is a narrow, localized maintenance and behavior correction.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit of this change is not demonstrated; it could have been a minor cleanup or a significant fix. The tier is assigned based on the conservative interpretation of the code, not the outcome.
